data.long_description:
Le Blanc Residence by Imtiaz is a premium residential development located in the heart of Dubailand, offering an elevated lifestyle defined by elegance and comfort. Designed with contemporary architecture and refined aesthetics, the project reflects Imtiaz Developments’ commitment to quality and detail.

All residences are delivered fully furnished with high-end finishes, thoughtfully selected materials, and modern interiors that maximize space and functionality. The layouts are designed to provide comfort, practicality, and a sophisticated living environment suitable for both residents and investors.

Residents enjoy access to resort-style amenities, including an infinity swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness center, and stylish communal spaces. Outdoor relaxation areas, BBQ zones, and leisure facilities create a balanced lifestyle within a well-connected and fast-growing community.
